source: kds1019/swing-finder-v3, core/pullback_reversal.py + core/trade_plan.py, imported directly (not re-implemented)

entry_rules.condition: not extended above value area (Close[T] <= value_area_high)

exit_rules.stop: min(10-day swing low, EMA20[T] - 1.3*ATR14[T]), refined to nearest support cluster (window=10) if within 3*ATR14
exit_rules.target: Fibonacci 1.618 extension of last 20 bars, floored at min_rr_ratio, refined to nearest resistance cluster if tighter and still clears floor

position_sizing.capital_model: independent $100,000 account per symbol, no cross-symbol capital sharing

benchmark: buy-and-hold of the same symbol, same warmup boundary/feed/adjustment/friction
known_deviations_from_skill_canonical_fo: EMA/ATR use pandas .ewm(adjust=False) (first-value-seeded) instead of this skill's SMA-seeded/Wilder-seeded canonical formulas, matching this project's actual core/indicators.py implementation. Converges to the canonical value within a few multiples of the span/period; not bit-identical near series start.
known_limitations: Universe/survivorship bias: symbols are today's live scan output replayed over history, not a point-in-time historical universe reconstruction.
Equity curve steps at trade open/close, not full daily mark-to-market of open positions -- Sharpe/max-drawdown are approximate. Hit rate/profit-factor/avg-R from round_trips.csv are not affected.
Trading-activity fees excluded (commissions-only friction modeled via slippage_bps).
